item.name: PADI Master Freediver Course
item.description:
#*PADI Master Freediver Course*

## Course Duration

•	4-Days
## Description

If you’re an advanced freediver who wants to learn how to fine-tune your lifestyle and training so that you can approach elite freediving levels, then the Master Freediver course is for you. Through focused sessions, you’ll bring your static apnea, dynamic apnea, free immersion, and constant weight skills to the next level.

## Course includes:

•	PADI-Master Freediver Online Materials
•	PADI-Certification fee
•	Classroom review & Final exam
•	Pool-Confined Water training session
•	4 Open Water training sessions


##Course Schedule

The PADI Master Freediver course consists of three main phases;
•	Classroom/Knowledge development about nutrition, relaxation, and advanced breathing techniques. You’ll study independently using the  Freediver online materials as well as an Instructor-led class session. You’ll also complete independent research as part of the Master Freediving Assignment.
•	Pool/Confined water session to improve static and dynamic apnea attempts, including a no fins dynamic apnea.
•	Goal – static apnea of 3 minutes, 30 seconds and dynamic apnea of 70m/230ft 
•	Open water sessions to practice mouth-fill equalization, perform warm-up and workup dives for free immersion and constant weight freediving.  
•	Goal – constant weight Freedive of 32 m/105ft, max 40m/130ft.

##Course Prerequisites

•	Be at least 18 years old. 
•	Advanced Freediver certification – or qualifying certification from other freediving training agencies – cross-over evaluation will be performed and will not be included in the course fee.
•	Have an Emergency First Responder (EFR) certificate or equivalent not older than 2 years.
•	Paperwork: Complete the MEDICAL FORM, the Liability Release, and the Statement of Understanding.

item.cancellation_notes:
**COURSE CANCELLATION / RESCHEDULING / NO SHOW POLICY**

•	72 Hour Cancellation Policy strictly enforced, NO exceptions! NO REFUNDS are issued if the cancellation notification is received less than 72 hours from the start of the tour or course as well in a NO SHOW incident, there will be a 100% cancellation fee charged to your credit card. 

•	Due to our group size limitations on some activities, we cannot absorb the cost of people canceling at the last minute, when we are turning away people from tours or courses that day.  When you give us your credit card information to hold a reservation, you are agreeing to the following cancellation terms and conditions:

•	Less than 14 days’ notice, but at least 7 days prior to start of the course, you may move into another course schedule with a $75 administration fee.

•	Less than 7 days’ notice, prior to start of the course, you may move into another course schedule with a 50% administration fee of the total course cost.

•	If the cancellation notification is received less than 7 days’ notice, but at least more than 72 hours from the start of the course, there will be a 50% cancellation fee charged.  

•	NO REFUNDS will be issued on PADI digital TouchTM study materials, used or unused.

•	No refunds will be issued for PRIVATE COURSE CANCELLATIONS, because we have booked and held those specific dates for you or your private group. (If you must change/cancel the course and we are able to fill the date, we will move the deposit/full payment to the new date, minus the 20% administration fee.

•	To complete a missing course session/segment for reasons other than weather cancellations, you may do so for $75 per day during any future course dates.

•	We reserve the right to cancel/reschedule the course/booked activity due to an unforeseen event or adverse weather/ocean condition or unsafe diving conditions and transfer the student to the next course convenient for the student or refund deposits fees received.

•	A full refund is given if the course is cancelled/rescheduled 72 hours prior to the dive date or if the dive(s) is cancelled by the Instructor due to unforeseen events, adverse weather/ocean condition or unsafe diving conditions.

•	DIVE CALIFORNIA cancellation policy supersedes all previous credit card agreements you have with your credit card company. Cancellations will be only accepted during business hours 9 to 6. We are open 7 Days A Week. Messages left on voicemail do not constitute an accepted cancellation!

•	If you are required to have a doctor's excuse for a "YES" answer on the medical waiver for any Scuba Dive or Certification class and if you fail to provide it BEFORE the start of your course you WILL NOT be permitted to dive and you WILL NOT receive a refund for the booking. Additionally, if you cannot swim and cannot complete your dives, you will not be given a refund. 

•	We reserve the right to cancel any course date if there are less than 3 students registered, in that case we will give no less than 1 week notice of the change and we do our best to assist your inconvenience by that change as we value your time and respect your busy schedule. In the event of a cancellation we will transfer you to the next upcoming course convenient to the student or refund deposits and fees received.

facts.hygiene_policy:
If you currently suffer from asthma, heart or brain problems, high-blood pressure, lung injuries, diabetes, epilepsy, or any recent injury or taking any kind of prescription medication, (except both control or anti-malarial drugs other than mefloquine/Lariam), you will not be able to dive with us without the signature of a physicians authorization. Without this, your activity may be canceled without a refund on the day of your activity.
